description: PATCH /white-label — update the agency's white-label branding, email settings, and visibility toggles. Domain changes and verification must go through the in-app flow. Returns the updated configuration with current domain status.

agency_staff_uses_custom_domain.description: Whether agency staff access Aidelly at a custom domain.

body.description: Optional body override for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

brand_name.description: Agency brand name shown to white-label clients.

button_text_color.description: Text/icon color on brand-colored buttons. 'auto' derives from luminance.

dark_logo_url.description: Dark-mode square logo URL. Falls back to logo_url if not set.

email_from_address.description: From email address for branded emails (must use a verified sending domain).

help_menu_url.description: URL for in-app help menu links.

hide_earn.description: Hide earnings/monetization surfaces from white-label clients.

logo_text_font_family.description: Font family name for logo text rendering.

logo_text_font_format.description: Font file format (woff2, woff, ttf, or otf).

logo_text_font_license_attested_at.description: ISO timestamp when font license was attested.

logo_text_font_storage_path.description: Internal storage path for the uploaded font file.

logo_text_font_url.description: Custom font URL for logo text in mark_text mode (must use https).

og_image_url.description: Open Graph image for social shares.

primary_color.description: Hex color for primary brand color (e.g.,

privacy_policy_url.description: Privacy policy URL for branded emails and legal links.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

saved_brand_preset.description:
Optional saved branding preset snapshot.
Set to null to clear the preset; omit to leave alone.

show_oauth_interstitial.description: Whether to show OAuth interstitial before social platform redirects.

sidebar_dark_full_logo_url.description: Dark-mode full sidebar logo URL. Falls back to sidebar_full_logo_url if not set.

sidebar_full_logo_url.description: Light-mode full sidebar logo URL (both mark and text).

sidebar_logo_mode.description: Sidebar rendering mode — square mark+text or full logo image.

support_email.description: Agency inbox email for white-label support submissions.

suppress_member_welcome_email.description:
Tri-state override for member welcome emails.
null = use plan default, true/false = explicit override.

terms_of_service_url.description: Terms of service URL for branded emails and legal links.

watermark_enabled_by_default.description: Whether to include watermark on newly generated reports.

watermark_settings.description: Watermark configuration object (null resets to defaults).

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in. Do not ask the user for this UUID — call aidelly_list_workspaces and use the `id` of the matching workspace. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_update_white_label_config
